question: What is the average track length in minutes?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(Milliseconds)/60000.0 AS DOUBLE) FROM TRACK;

question: Give the names of tracks longer than 20 minutes.
sql: SELECT Name FROM TRACK WHERE Milliseconds > 20000;
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 20 * 60000;

question: List the titles of all albums by AC/DC.
sql: SELECT T2.Title FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId WHERE T1.ArtistId = 1;
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC';
error: BinderException: Binder Error: Table "T2" does not have a column named "Title"

question: Which 3 artists sold the most tracks? Show the artist name and number of tracks sold, from most to least.
sql: SELECT a.Name AS artist_name, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Artist a JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 3;
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, sum(il.Quantity) AS sold FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY sold DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Rank the species by average bill length, longest first. Show the rank, species, and average bill length.
sql: SELECT RANK(), species, AVG(bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY avg_bill DESC;
gold_sql: SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY avg(bill_length_mm) DESC) AS rnk, species, avg(bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY rnk;
error: CatalogException: Catalog Error: Scalar Function with name rank does not exist!

question: Which countries had a GDP per capita above their region's average in 2023?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 AND cs.gdp_per_capita_usd > (SELECT AVG(gdp_per_capita_usd) FROM country_stats cs2 JOIN countries c2 ON cs2.iso3 = c2.iso3 WHERE c2.region = c.region);
gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT c.name, c.region, s.gdp_per_capita_usd AS g FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023) SELECT name FROM x WHERE g > (SELECT avg(g) FROM x AS y WHERE y.region = x.region);
